newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: IFC launches first Philippine peso Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: IFC launches first Philippine peso Eurobond.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) has launched the first Eurobond issue denominated in Philippine pesos, lead manager Citicorp International Ltd said on Monday.
The issue is worth 2.6 billion pesos and carries a coupon of 10.25 percent, a Citicorp statement said.
The issue price and the reoffer price are yet to be set.
Besides this issue, the Philippine Monetary Board had approved the issue of another Eurobond to be lead managed by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Last week, the Central Bank of the Philippines said it expected a warm reception to these issues due to the recent upgrade of the country's sovereign rating by Standard and Poor's Corp.
